errors.evidence: The chart does not specify units for the values on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly states that the values are percentages.

errors.text_span: Die Länder sind innerhalb der beiden Gruppen nicht nach Größe sortiert
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The 'Verlierer' (top group) are sorted in descending order of their negative values (from -16.3 to -9.4). The 'Gewinner' (bottom group) are sorted in ascending order of their positive values (from 23.3 to 67.7).
